title: Definitions shared by the content schemas
description: The words every content schema uses the same way: the review status of an item, the evidence type of a value, the kind of a number and the shape of a register reference. Other schemas point here with $ref so the lists exist once. The source register (docs/research/source_register.csv) is where each value's evidence type, walkthrough reference and review state are recorded; a content file points at it with refs.

review_status.description: How far an item has been reviewed. A session in practice mode may use APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING or above; assessment mode only APPROVED_FOR_ASSESSMENT; a DRAFT or CLINICAL_REVIEW item is never played (the content gate, T-CL-2). GENERATED_PRACTICE_ONLY is a case composed by the generator: practice only, never assessment, never raised by the generator itself, and only with created_by composer.

evidence_type.description: A source-backed, B interpretation of a source, C institution-dependent (a placeholder), D simulator design value.

number_kind.description: REFERENCE generally expected, ABNORMAL outside the usual range, CONCERN triggers more assessment, CRITICAL potentially immediate danger, SIM_TRIGGER chosen by the simulator to create a scenario (Implementation Guide, number kinds).

register_ref.description: A row of the source register.
